purpose: Define the executable replacement-baseline protocol when the paper's original seven baseline outputs are unavailable.
scope_note: This protocol is not an exact Table 1 reproduction unless the same seven baseline outputs and Gemini-3-flash judge records from the paper are imported. It is a pinned substitute protocol for rerunning available systems under the recovered 30-query evaluation.

candidate_baselines.name: AI-Researcher
candidate_baselines.next_action: Install in an isolated checkout, feed the 30 verbatim queries, normalize outputs into the shared layout, then judge against EvoScientist.

candidate_baselines.name: InternAgent
candidate_baselines.next_action: Install in an isolated checkout, feed the 30 verbatim queries, normalize outputs into the shared layout, then judge against EvoScientist.

candidate_baselines.name: AI Scientist-v2
candidate_baselines.next_action: Install in an isolated checkout, feed the 30 verbatim queries, normalize outputs into the shared layout, then judge against EvoScientist.

candidate_baselines.name: Novix
candidate_baselines.next_action: Use only if service access and a stable export path are available; normalize exported answers into the shared layout.

candidate_baselines.name: K-Dense
candidate_baselines.next_action: Use hosted or open-source tooling if access/setup succeeds; normalize exported answers into the shared layout.

acceptance_checks: Every selected baseline has 30 non-empty answer.txt files under the shared system-output layout.
Each answer is generated from the verbatim recovered query goal and records the prompt used.
Pairwise judge inputs contain 60 swapped records per selected baseline.
Judge outputs cover every comparison_id in the generated judge inputs.
Aggregate JSON contains Clarity, Novelty, Feasibility, and Relevance for each selected baseline.
The report states whether the comparison is paper-exact or replacement-only.
